extracted.name: Peanut butter overnight oats
extracted.description: Make a bowl of overnight oats that's indulgent yet healthy with creamy peanut butter and tangy raspberries. Or make it in a jar and take it to work
instruction_lines: Stir the frozen raspberries into your oats with 150ml water and a pinch of salt, then cover and chill in the fridge overnight.
The next day, mix in the maple syrup, then top the oats with the peanut butter.
